```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Polluters should pay full cleanup costs, including the mitigation of later health problems in exposed communities.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Eliminating pollution sources that belong in nobody’s backyard is possible only when there are no more powerless communities to serve as environmental dumps.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The atmosphere, oceans, lakes, rivers and groundwater, soils and natural ecosystems must be recognized as commons belonging to everyone and managed democratically.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"If left to the logic of the private market, the atmosphere, oceans, lakes, rivers and groundwater, soils and natural ecosystems will be exploited to extinction.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Our posterity will inherit a healthy planet only if we end the profit-driven throwaway corporate economy and replace it with a production system designed for systematic reuse and recycling of materials.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The global climate system is in grave peril from the unrestricted use of fossil fuels.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Conditions incompatible with those that made human civilization possible are approaching due to the unrestricted use of fossil fuels.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"A transition to renewable energy and innovation in energy productivity can continue to raise living standards.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Quality of life can improve even more with cultural change toward “fewer belongings and more belonging”.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[3]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
